prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a gorgeous original fantasy archipelago world map illustration for Naki, a Unity 2D RPG. Landscape canvas 1536x1024, beautifully painted pixel-art/detailed pixel clusters, aged parchment margins, rich teal ocean with subtle currents and small cloud wisps, cohesive storybook atlas, readable terrain silhouettes. EXACT seven separated islands at these normalized coordinates measured from TOP LEFT, generous sea between landmasses and outer margins. 1 west-central at x=.12 y=.48: fertile homeland coastal kingdom, small pale castle with red roofs and farms. 2 southwest at x=.32 y=.68: sandy golden desert island with ruined sandstone temple, tiny oasis, wind-shaped dunes. 3 central at x=.48 y=.40: green-gray thunder highland island with steep mountain, storm cloud and blue lightning contained over peak. 4 northeast at x=.72 y=.21: icy island with snowy mountain, blue fjord harbor, glacier and lighthouse. 5 southeast at x=.83 y=.68: volcanic island with dark basalt coast and glowing red-orange caldera, small forge town, no snowy mountain. 6 southern center at x=.57 y=.78: lush deep green woodland island with enormous ancient tree, winding river and misty shore. 7 north-central at x=.40 y=.16: ominous rocky island bearing a Gothic knight manor with dark slate roofs and purple windows, cold cliffs, subdued mysterious atmosphere. Island scale roughly .13 of canvas width, forest and homeland slightly larger. Coastlines organic, elegant delicate gold map border. Clear sea around each island for interface overlays. NO text, NO letters, NO numbers, NO labels, NO UI panels, NO compass rose over an island, NO drawn travel route. Fixed geographic placement is critical. Atmospheric and refined, no photorealism.
